proof_scope: Pinned pipeline and ordinary imported SQL plans; excludes hand-built plans that inject physical JoinAlgo plus residual filters before CBO.
original_final_finding_scope: Late residual-join reconstruction recreates Replicate after the sole copy stage when block joins and spilling are disabled.
proof: Every left-family residual that requires reconstruction under the fixed block/force flags is processed by the added early pass, before copying.
A residual join retained by that pass has block joins enabled, at least one equality condition and forced inlining disabled.
It cannot later receive Lookup or LookupReverse from CBO because both packing paths exclude nonempty JoinFilters.

CBO-created joins start without JoinFilters. Remaining intervening rules do not attach residual filters to left-family joins. The only attachment targets Cross, whose inlining uses a Filter rather than Replicate.

No stage between these inlining passes changes the UseBlockHashJoin or force-inlining configuration values. Binding substitution and pruning preserve the nonempty key/equality condition needed by the early return.

Therefore the late pass cannot newly create left-family reconstruction sharing for the supposed retained-block/Lookup path. Adding fallback or relaxing Copy would introduce unnecessary behavior changes.

source_evidence.claim: Early inlining precedes copy expansion, storage rewrites and CBO; late inlining precedes physical lookup lowering.
Only left-family residual reconstruction creates Replicate. Surviving block-capable keyed residual joins return unchanged unless force or Lookup eligibility changes.
Initial CBO packing requires empty residual filters.
CBO expansion also rejects residual-filter joins, including an outer join above a packed child.
CBO result import creates joins without residual filters before attaching its selected algorithm.
The only residual attachment in stages between CBO and late inlining is guarded by JoinKind Cross. It cannot create left-family reconstruction sharing.
This rule only removes or retains existing residual conjuncts; it cannot introduce a new left-family residual.
The intervening block mode rule changes expression BlockEngineMode, not the UseBlockHashJoin or force-inlining flags read by both inlining stages.
Post-CBO inlining performs binding substitutions, without introducing residual predicates or changing physical join eligibility.
Binding renaming retains join keys and residual operator structure.
Copy expansion remains deliberately gated by repeatability and Copy support; no amendment should bypass those gates.
Repeatability does not admit physical TableLookup; generic CopyImpl returns nullptr for unsupported operators.
